profile.name: Justice Amankrah
profile.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer & Technical Team Lead
profile.tagline: Building scalable systems, leading cross-continental teams, integrating AI into enterprise workflows.
profile.bio_short: Senior Full-Stack Engineer with 6+ years of experience designing and delivering production-grade applications across Africa, the US, UAE, and Australia. I specialise in the Python and React/Next.js ecosystems, lead teams of engineers through complex architectural migrations, and integrate AI to solve real operational problems.
profile.bio_long: I'm Justice Amankrah — a Senior Full-Stack Engineer and Technical Team Lead based in Accra, Ghana, with over six years of hands-on experience turning complex requirements into scalable, maintainable software.My work spans the full stack: from architecting FastAPI microservices backends and building RAG pipelines with LangChain, to crafting performant React/Next.js frontends and managing CI/CD pipelines across distributed infrastructure. I currently lead a team of five engineers at DevOps Africa Limited, coordinating across the US, UAE, and Australia time zones to deliver enterprise systems for international clients.I care deeply about clean architecture, developer experience, and building tools that non-technical users can actually use. Whether it's migrating a legacy Odoo monolith, implementing an AI-powered document search system, or delivering a pixel-perfect SaaS product from a Figma file — I bring the same discipline and attention to detail to every project.Outside of work, I'm passionate about the African tech ecosystem, exploring startup opportunities suited to the Ghanaian market, and mentoring the next generation of engineers.
profile.availability: Open to relocation — EU Blue Card eligible

projects.title: AI-Powered Enterprise Search (FDA Compliance System)
projects.summary: A natural language querying system built for pharmaceutical clients to extract and query clinical and non-clinical domain data for FDA SENDIG submission. Reduced data processing time by 85%.
projects.description: Enterprise-grade AI document search tool that allows non-technical pharmaceutical researchers to query complex ERP data using plain English. Built with a local AI infrastructure using Ollama, LangChain, and DeepSeek AI models — keeping sensitive data on-premises. The system generates SENDIG-compliant .XPT files for FDA submission, automating what was previously a manual, error-prone process.
projects.problem: Pharmaceutical researchers needed to query and compile FDA-compliant clinical trial data from a complex ERP system, but lacked technical skills. Manual data extraction was slow and error-prone.
projects.solution: Built a RAG pipeline over the ERP database with a conversational interface, allowing users to ask questions in plain English and receive structured, compliance-ready outputs.
impact: 85% improvement in data processing efficiency
Eliminated manual data extraction errors
SENDIG-compliant .XPT file generation fully automated
Non-technical staff can now self-serve data queries
projects.image_prompt: AI dashboard showing pharmaceutical data extraction with charts and query interface, dark blue enterprise UI

projects.title: FastAPI Microservices Migration Framework
projects.summary: Architected and executed the migration of 20+ enterprise Odoo monolithic applications into a modern FastAPI microservices architecture for international clients, improving deployment speed by 40%.
projects.description: Led a full architectural overhaul replacing a tightly coupled Odoo monolith with independently deployable FastAPI microservices. Included designing a custom API Gateway with JWT auth, Redis caching, service discovery, and a reusable Python migration framework for extracting and transforming legacy Odoo data into clean PostgreSQL schemas.
projects.problem: A suite of 20+ enterprise Odoo applications had grown into an unmaintainable monolith. Deployments were slow and risky, and individual services could not scale independently.
projects.solution: Designed a microservices architecture with a custom API Gateway, implemented Redis caching, and built reusable migration scripts to transform legacy data. Introduced Git-flow and CI/CD pipelines for reliable multi-region deployments.
impact: 40% improvement in deployment speed
25% reduction in internal service latency
Zero-downtime deployments across US, UAE, and Australia regions
Independent scalability for each microservice
projects.image_prompt: Microservices architecture diagram with API gateway, multiple services, and database connections on dark background

impact: Fully offline-capable — works in areas with poor connectivity
Mobile Money integration removes friction from fee collection
Digital records replace error-prone paper systems

about_sections.headline: I build things that scale — from enterprise microservices to AI-powered tools for African markets.

values.title: Clean Architecture
values.description: I believe software should be maintainable long after the initial build. Every system I design is built with clear separation of concerns, sensible abstractions, and documentation that the next developer will thank you for.

values.title: Shipping Real Value
values.description: I measure success by impact, not lines of code. Whether it's a 70% reduction in inventory errors or enabling non-technical staff to query data in plain English — I build things that move the needle.

values.title: African Tech Innovation
values.description: Ghana and Africa represent one of the world's most exciting software markets. I'm passionate about building products that address real local problems — from offline-first PWAs to Mobile Money integrations.

values.title: Team Leadership
values.description: The best software is built by well-led, motivated teams. I lead with clarity, conduct thorough code reviews, and invest in the growth of everyone around me — across time zones, cultures, and skill levels.
